listitem.para: Whether &Libreswan; should negotiate the IKEv2 downgrade-prevention extension.This setting overrides every connection's own ike-sa-init-full-transcript-auth= setting.
Always negotiate and require the extension, for every connection, regardless of that connection's own ike-sa-init-full-transcript-auth= setting.
Never negotiate the extension, for every connection, regardless of that connection's own ike-sa-init-full-transcript-auth= setting.
Defer to each connection's own ike-sa-init-full-transcript-auth= setting.
